family_profiles.family: Data integrity, tradability and visual integrity
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: bar availability, complete-bar flags, raw/adjusted price-basis ID, instrument master, exchange calendar, duplicate keys, OHLC validity, volume quality, renderer hash, image endpoint timestamps.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Before any pattern or model score is evaluated, verify that each image and feature row is derived from bars available at the sample cutoff. Treat data gates as binary hard controls. If one required timeframe is unknown or stale, return `BLOCKED` or `ABSTAIN`; do not substitute a later bar.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Reject future or partial candles in the completed-bar baseline; reject image/source lineage mismatch; reject halted/non-tradable instruments and missing warm-up. Preserve quarantine reason codes.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Create synthetic tests for duplicate bars, impossible OHLC, missing weekly bar, late vendor availability, adjusted/unadjusted mismatch, future chart annotation and renderer version mismatch. A past sample must remain byte-identical when future bars are changed.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: causal weekly swing sequence, pivot confirmation age, weekly MA slopes, ADX/DI, return persistence, range width, ATR percentile, major weekly zone distance, benchmark/sector state if point-in-time available.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Emit one weekly state (`BULL_TREND`, `BEAR_TREND`, `RANGE`, `TRANSITION`, `HIGH_VOL_DISORDERLY`, `UNKNOWN`) plus side permissions. Weekly context sets preference and blocks unsupported strategies; it never provides the hourly order price.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: A single moving-average cross, one green/red candle or one unconfirmed swing is insufficient. Countertrend trades require their own tagged family, stricter trigger and separate validation.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Measure state stability and transition lag by market regime. Compare against simple MA and swing-only baselines. Report false permission rates and performance of each permitted strategy family.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: daily confirmed pivots, BOS/CHoCH levels and confirmation times, protected swing, trend/range classification, close beyond level, follow-through, retest depth, setup age.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: A daily setup object must contain family, direction, location, source bar, thesis invalidation, first obstacle, trigger requirement and expiry. Distinguish occurrence time from confirmation/availability time for all pivots and breaks.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: No setup advances to hourly timing when the daily thesis is already invalidated, too old, conflicted or missing a measurable invalidation. A daily close outside a range should be distinguished from a wick through the boundary.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test wick-only breach versus close acceptance; one-bar false breaks; pivot confirmation delay; setup ageing; and daily/weekly disagreement. Verify the same setup is not re-created on every hourly sample without a stable setup ID.

family_profiles.family: Support, resistance, supply/demand and level geometry
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: zone proximal/distal boundaries, zone width/ATR, creation time, confirmed reactions, touch count, spacing between touches, penetration depth, reclaim close, first opposing obstacle.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Represent zones as price intervals with method, origin time, confirmation time and quality attributes. Cluster overlapping levels before scoring; one price area must not produce multiple independent votes.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Reject midpoint entries in a range when the edge strategy requires location. Reject when first obstacle leaves insufficient net target space. Do not widen/shift a zone after seeing the trade outcome.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Perturb zone boundaries within a predeclared tolerance and measure signal sensitivity. Test false breaks, shallow penetrations, repeated tests and zone-age decay. Compare zone rules against simple rolling swing levels.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: preceding trend, candle body/wick ratios, body engulfment, shared high/low tolerance, three-candle sequence, location, next-candle confirmation, intervening swing break.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Pattern geometry is necessary but not sufficient. Require appropriate prior context and location; define candle formulas numerically and use the next completed hourly bar or a specified close/level event as confirmation.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: A hammer in a strong downtrend away from support is not equivalent to a hammer at daily support. A doji or one reversal candle does not itself prove a reversal. Keep long/short pattern definitions symmetric only where mathematically appropriate.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Create balanced positive and near-miss examples. Test sensitivity to tick/ATR tolerance, body ratio, wick ratio and pattern sequence. Report precision and conditional net R by location and weekly regime.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: impulse size/ATR, pullback depth, range overlap, inside-bar nesting, parent range, flag channel slope, compression duration, breakout close location, chase distance.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Identify the parent impulse/compression causally. The trigger is the completed break of the declared boundary; store parent range, trigger price, expiry and invalidation. Direction is not assigned merely because an inside bar or triangle exists.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Reject late entries after excessive travel from the trigger. Reject a flag whose countertrend channel breaks before resumption. Treat gap continuation with the next executable session price and gap-risk model.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test breakout direction symmetry, nested-range edge cases, compression length, breakout close location, failed follow-through and gap-open cancellation. Compare close-confirmed versus stop-entry policies.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: prior range boundary, preceding N-bar extrema excluding current bar, closing penetration, relative volume, time-of-day volume baseline, retest distance, acceptance closes, next obstacle.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Separate breakout detection from order timing: first define the level from past bars, then require a completed close/acceptance, then wait for retest or hourly trigger when that family requires it. Keep breakout and retest as separate event states.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Reject threshold calculations that accidentally include the current high/low. Reject a breakout where the next weekly/daily obstacle is too close or the actual fill creates unacceptable chase/stop geometry.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test parameter N, close buffer, relative-volume horizon, retest tolerance and maximum age on training/validation only. Record no-fill, gap-through and false-break outcomes with execution costs.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: impulse anchor, retracement fraction, protected daily swing, moving-average distance/ATR, VWAP/session ID, prior-day high/low, reclaim/hold bars, hourly swing trigger.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: The daily chart defines the pullback zone and protected structure; hourly confirmation is a fresh reclaim, rejection, higher low/lower high or level break. Session VWAP is computed only from data available in that session.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: A moving-average/VWAP touch is location context, not a trigger. Reject if the protected daily swing breaks or if price is already too extended. Prior-day levels must use the previous completed session, not the current day's eventual high/low.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Compare shallow/deep pullbacks and average types. Test VWAP by session phase. Measure continuation probability and MAE after trigger, not just pattern accuracy.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: average values/slopes, fast/slow ordering, cross age, price distance/ATR, regression channel fit and residual, swing structure, extension percentile.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Use averages/channels as context and regime evidence. A crossover is lagging and should require independent price structure/trigger confirmation. Store the average distance and slope continuously, not only a binary cross.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not count SMA20/EMA20/SMA50/EMA50 as independent confluence. Reject when extension makes stop or target geometry infeasible. A channel touch alone is not a reversal.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Ablate each average family; compare with price-only structure. Test rising/falling/flat regimes, whipsaw ranges and parameter stability. Report turnover and net performance after costs.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: RSI level/slope/cross age, price and oscillator confirmed pivots, MACD line/signal/histogram, zero-line context, histogram contraction/re-expansion, price structure confirmation.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Divergence uses confirmed pivot pairs and becomes actionable only after the intervening price swing breaks. MACD and RSI are momentum evidence; price structure remains the trigger/invalidator.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not short solely because RSI > 70 or buy solely because RSI < 30. In strong trends, persistent overbought/oversold conditions are possible. Conflicting momentum and price structure should produce a lower score or abstention.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Use fixed indicator conventions. Test divergence confirmation delay and false divergence rate. Group RSI/MACD in one momentum evidence family for confluence. Evaluate by trend/range regime.

family_profiles.family: Volume, OBV, participation and volume quality
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: relative volume, time-slot baseline, volume z-score/percentile, OBV slope/pivots, A/D slope, profile node location, volume missingness and anomaly score.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Normalize volume by instrument and time/session. Volume-derived features confirm or weaken a price setup; they do not determine direction without price acceptance. Store source volume quality and whether the market's volume is consolidated or venue-specific.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Block or mark unknown when volume is missing/anomalous. Do not compare raw share volume across different securities. A volume spike can be climactic or informative; location and candle close determine interpretation.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test volume features against price-only baselines. Use same-time-of-day controls for hourly bars. Include missing-volume and abnormal-feed cases. Measure incremental value in distinct liquidity buckets.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: ATR level/percentile, Bollinger width/%B, Keltner width if used, range expansion ratio, gap size/ATR, opening range, stop distance, target room.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Classify compression, normal, expansion and shock regimes. Volatility determines whether the setup family is supported, how far price has moved and whether the stop/quantity combination is feasible. It does not predict direction by itself.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Reject chase entries after extreme expansion unless a separately tested momentum policy permits them. Treat gap entries at the first executable quote/session price. Do not use an ATR multiplier as a substitute for structural invalidation.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Use rolling, train-only regime thresholds or pre-registered fixed thresholds. Test gap and shock periods separately; stress stops and costs. Verify quantity falls as stop distance increases.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: weekly regime/permission, daily setup ID and invalidation, hourly trigger type/age, cross-timeframe direction vector, obstacle clearance, stop consistency.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Use the strict hierarchy: weekly permission → daily setup → hourly trigger → candidate plan → risk approval. Store each view's exact source bar and age. An hourly signal cannot alter what the weekly/daily bars said at that time.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: If weekly and daily conflict, route only to a separately validated countertrend family or abstain. If the daily invalidation is beyond the feasible risk budget, skip rather than pulling the stop inward to fit.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Ablate each timeframe. Compare weekly+daily, daily+hourly, weekly+hourly and all-three. Test stale-view handling, regime transition and disagreement cases.

family_profiles.family: Events, sweeps, external context and final audit
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: event calendar availability timestamp, post-event range, known prior liquidity pool, sweep/reclaim depth, index/sector point-in-time features, market shock flag, family-level confluence and audit lineage.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: External event/index/sector data must be point-in-time and timestamped. A liquidity sweep requires a previously known level and a completed reclaim/rejection. Final audit data is mandatory even when the candidate is rejected.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not use revised macro data or current index membership in historical features. Do not trade ordinary patterns in unvalidated shock/event windows. Do not call a weighted score a probability unless calibrated.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test event-time leakage, constituent survivorship, index/sector feature lag and sweep confirmation. Every output must be reproducible from its audit record.

family_profiles.family: Advanced trigger, execution and final approval
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: partial-bar snapshot if enabled, retest attempt count, candle close location, retest hold duration, pullback overlap, spread/depth, session phase, order age, fill estimate and independent gate vector.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: The completed-bar baseline and any intrabar-nowcasting model must be separate products. Trigger validity expires on a failed level, age limit, session expiry or chase threshold. Recalculate reward-to-risk using expected/actual fill.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Cancel stale unfilled orders. Do not chase a lost trigger. A candidate is rejected if any hard gate fails; model score cannot bypass data, liquidity, stop, cost or portfolio vetoes.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test partial-bar causality separately, order non-fill/partial-fill behavior, session effects, post-fill risk and idempotent order submission. Verify that raising model confidence cannot change a blocked candidate to approved.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: entry price/time, side, causal protected swing, pattern extreme, zone boundary, breakout level, invalidation timeframe, tick size and spread.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Select the stop from the thesis invalidation first; then evaluate whether its distance is feasible. The stop must be on the protective side of entry and outside normal structural noise according to the predeclared buffer policy.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Never move a structural stop closer solely to make quantity fit. If stop distance is too large, reduce quantity or reject the trade. Distinguish a close-confirmed thesis exit from an intrabar protective stop.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test long/short symmetry, gap-through behavior, tick rounding, structure confirmation time and stop feasibility. Assert that every accepted candidate has a valid stop.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: ATR at entry and current time, ATR percentile/change, trailing extreme, stop distance, spread, volatility shock, partial-fill quantity and cost to breakeven.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Compute ATR and trailing levels from completed bars using one smoothing convention. Update stops only according to an explicitly defined monotonic policy; long protective stops may ratchet up but not down, short protective stops may ratchet down but not up.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not widen a stop. Breakeven means net-of-cost breakeven under the declared fill/fee assumptions, not simply entry price. Recalculate risk after every partial fill.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Replay volatility expansions/contractions, gaps and partial fills. Property-test stop monotonicity and ensure no future high/low is used to update a trail before it is available.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: first opposing zone, range midpoint/boundary, measured-move origin and width, Fibonacci anchor IDs, prior weekly/daily levels, VWAP/profile nodes, cost-adjusted target space.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Define target from a level or objective fixed at entry time. Store the calculation method, anchors, timestamp and price. Recompute expected net reward-to-risk after entry estimate and cost changes; do not move target retrospectively to the realized high.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: If opposing structure truncates reward below the validated minimum, reduce quantity only if the policy supports it or reject/exit; do not claim a 1:2 ratio from a distant theoretical level that price cannot reasonably reach.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Compare target methods on identical candidate events. Test anchor selection, target stability, obstacle truncation and costs. Report target hit rates and net R by target family.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: initial R, current R, maximum favorable excursion so far, partial quantity, remaining quantity, confirmed swing trail, ATR trail, target ladder and giveback fraction.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Every partial exit must specify the fraction/quantity, trigger, order type and management of the remaining position. Track realized P&L separately from unrealized P&L and update the remaining position's risk.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not describe a partial profit as risk-free if the remaining quantity can still lose money. Do not move a stop to breakeven before the rule's condition is met. Compare staged exits against a simple full-exit baseline.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Pathwise simulate partial fills, stop/target ordering, runner tails and giveback. Report total net R, not just the best partial fill. Stress commission/spread on every fill.

family_profiles.family: Trend, momentum, volume and efficiency deterioration
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: RSI regime and slope, MACD histogram changes, confirmed divergence pivots, ADX/DI slope, average reclaim/failure, OBV slope, volume climax and directional efficiency.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Treat indicator deterioration as a warning or reduction proposal unless the exit rule explicitly defines a confirmed price-level failure. Maintain separate warning, reduce and hard-exit thresholds.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not exit a strong trend solely because RSI is high or MACD histogram contracts for one bar. Correlated momentum indicators should be grouped; a warning must not be counted as multiple independent exit confirmations.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Measure incremental value beyond a static stop/target. Report false early exits, captured favorable excursion and tail-loss reduction by weekly regime.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: opposing candle body/wicks, prior trend extension, target/support-resistance location, pattern confirmation bars, original pattern high/low and follow-through.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Pattern recognition must use completed bars and must be conditioned on position direction and location. A warning candle can stop new adds or trigger a partial; a full exit needs the defined confirmation or invalidation condition.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not exit solely on a doji or isolated wick without location/context unless that is the pre-registered strategy. Preserve the original entry pattern and compare its defining extreme to current price causally.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test pattern false positives across trend/range regimes. Record whether the exit improves net R and downside distribution versus stop-only and target-only baselines.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: thesis timeframe, protected pivot and confirmation timestamp, BOS/CHoCH state, support/resistance acceptance, sweep/reclaim levels, breakout retest and range boundary.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Exit when the structure that justified the position fails at the timeframe declared by the setup. Separate first warning from confirmed thesis invalidation. An hourly counter-swing should not automatically invalidate a weekly thesis unless the strategy is hourly-defined.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not use retrospectively confirmed pivots at their occurrence time. A sweep against the position needs a known prior liquidity level and a completed reclaim/rejection before model-driven action.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test single-bar wick breaches versus close acceptance, pivot confirmation delay, failed retests and timeframe downgrade logic. Use exact stop/exit fill assumptions.

family_profiles.family: Time, stalling, expiry and opportunity cost
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: bars held, elapsed time, expected progress threshold, realized favorable excursion, peak-to-current retracement, setup family, range/trend state, trigger/order age and alternative opportunity score.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Time exits must be conditional on the strategy's expected holding period. A breakout strategy, range mean-reversion strategy and weekly trend strategy need different expiry policies. Opportunity-cost rotation is portfolio-level and includes switching costs.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: Do not use future best price to decide when a stall occurred. The `bars_since_peak` feature is online state. Cancel an unfilled entry after its expiry; do not convert it into a filled trade.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Compare time stops with no-time-stop controls. Report capital utilization, net R, missed later continuation, loss avoided and sensitivity to holding horizon.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: event schedule as known at decision time, gap size, first executable quote, spread/depth, halt/limit state, short borrow/fees, corporate actions, fill slippage and intended versus filled quantity.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Execution events are state changes, not chart patterns. Use first executable prices for gaps, pause or reject during halts, reconcile corporate actions, and recalculate risk from actual fills. Event filters must use only information published/available at the decision time.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: A stop price is not a guaranteed fill. Stop-limit orders may fail to fill. Borrow recall/fee rules can force covers independently of a technical model. Do not assume continuous liquidity through a halt.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Stress gap and spread scenarios; inject partial fill, no fill, halt, recall and split events. Verify simulated costs and actual quantity reconciliation.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: account equity, positions and actual fills, open stop risk, stressed gap risk, sector/factor/index exposure, margin, FX, daily loss, weekly drawdown and kill-switch state.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Evaluate risk at portfolio level after each fill and market update. Use actual positions and a consistent mark-to-market convention. Correlation/concentration should be measured on point-in-time returns and exposures.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: A trade-level risk limit does not guarantee the portfolio is safe when many correlated trades are open. Portfolio hard limits override a model's hold recommendation. Do not rely on stop orders to guarantee maximum loss through gaps.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Replay simultaneous signals, correlated shock, FX move, margin increase and drawdown thresholds. Test that no new position is approved after a kill switch.

family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: order/position state, fill IDs, weighted average price, remaining quantity, model/policy version, current risk, event log, calibration health and supported-regime status.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Manage positions through explicit states: PLANNED, SUBMITTED, PARTIAL, OPEN, REDUCING, CLOSED, CANCELLED, REJECTED. Reconcile with broker/source of truth and keep the model version attached to the position lifecycle.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: A position cannot be considered closed merely because an exit order was submitted. Do not let a new model silently take control of an old position unless migration policy is explicit. Keep protective orders intact during model/data outages.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Test duplicate order prevention, out-of-order acknowledgements, partial fills, reconnect/reconciliation, model-version change and data kill-switch behavior.

family_profiles.family: Model-aware exit, uncertainty and rule governance
family_profiles.Required measurable inputs: conditional-on-open-position dataset, future-horizon return distribution, stop-before-target probability, calibrated quantiles, entropy/ensemble/OOD score, rule/model conflict and rule performance history.
family_profiles.Operational predicate and state: Train exit decisions on open-trade states only. Calibrate conditional probabilities and quantiles on a chronological holdout. Map model outputs to hold/reduce/exit through a validated policy; the hard stop and portfolio controls remain external.
family_profiles.Reject, invalidate or abstain when: An untrained uncertainty head is not uncertainty. Use calibrated entropy, ensembles, conformal methods or another validated estimator. Disable model-driven exits when calibration drifts or inputs are out of distribution.
family_profiles.Minimum test suite: Measure decision utility versus static exit policies, calibration by regime, false exits, tail losses and rule retirement stability. Keep historical rule/model outputs for audit.
